ADMINISTRATIVE_SCOPE: Trusted qualification owner/launcher control; no promise against administrator deletion, filesystem rollback, malicious privileged actor or unauthorized bypass. Such events invalidate environment/authority and deny further launch
AUDIT: Append-only separate claim/launch/outcome evidence pins; claim state remains consumed independent of audit availability
CONCURRENCY: Winner crash leaves reservation blocked; stale locks never reopen
Missing store after previously activated environment is integrity loss, not fresh authority
FAILURE_POLICY: Unknown state, permission, fsync, verifier, resource, lifecycle or integrity fails closed; no launch/no retry
POWER_LOSS_ASSURANCE: Not claimed. Launch blocked unless required filesystem ordering/persistence guarantee is independently evidenced. Controlled process-crash testing cannot prove power-loss behavior
REVOCATION: Fresh authoritative owner epoch required, deny unknown revocation/expiry. Epoch serialization prevents a separate grant change racing claim/launch within governed protocol
STABLE_STORE: One dedicated local filesystem directory under host-capability-verification/h77-02-consumption, actual absolute host path/device/ownership pinned by future host profile. Not /tmp, not campaign-budget.jsonl
STEPS: Read exact issued grant, separate effective reference, original subject and current authority lifecycle; reject absent/changed/revoked/expired/missing freshness
Verify exact command/environment/binary pins, resources, host profile, input/output and actual permissions without privilege acquisition
Take authority-owner serialized administrative epoch lock; revocation/update uses same protocol. Keep lock through claim and one launch handoff; unsupported lifecycle synchronization denies launch
Compute deterministic key. Resolve trusted pinned store via directory fd with no-follow checks and owner-only access; reject unqualified remote/overlay/replaceable/multiple-instance store
Use openat(dirfd,key.sha256+.claim.json,O_WRONLY|O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW,0600), atomically creating permanent reservation. No exists-then-create admission
Existing pathname of any type, stale lock, partial, conflicting or malformed record means consumed/ambiguous: reject; no repair/reset/removal
Write complete canonical consumption record binding key/identities/state CONSUMED. Check exact write length; flush file/fsync(file), then fsync(store directory)
Trusted independent read-only verifier reopens by descriptor/no-follow, confirms exact identity/bytes/inode and barrier-success evidence; reread alone does not prove crash durability
Only this first claimant may receive one process-local nonserializable launch capability after barrier and verifier success. Recovery readers never mint capabilities from records
Recheck authoritative epoch under same lock and exact invocation; invalidate one-shot capability before spawn. Launch once or fail; release lock only after handoff. Never resubmit capability

Append separately exclusive identity-bearing audit outcomes. Error after claim cannot remove consumption. Record LAUNCHED only from actual process creation evidence, completion only from independent wait/exit evidence
